title: Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish made with chicken, zesty saffron, and a variety of vegetables. This paella recipe is a staple of Spanish cuisine.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and tomato to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the rice to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, saffron, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is heated through.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or lemon wedges if desired.
